content:
- Applied improve-code-boundaries smell 10 in src/process/worker.rs by removing the one-caller inbox-drain helper and inlining that behavior into step_once.
- Added a step_once behavior test proving only the latest queued request is rejected when the worker is busy; make lint and make test both passed afterward.
- Committed as 2e92cc0 and pushed to origin/master, then ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh; current task summaries were updated and the script again printed a harmless missing .ralph/current_task.txt removal message. If resuming later, note there are still unrelated pre-existing dirty files plus new post-switch .ralph changes in the worktree.

- Read prior progress and loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill instructions.
- Confirmed there are pending found_smells files, so this run must use one of those first.
- Checked git status and Makefile; make test uses cargo nextest, so it is compatible with the repo rule against cargo test.

- Chose the found smell in src/ha/process_dispatch.rs rather than touching the user's existing dirty files.
- The boundary issue is the unused RuntimeConfig threaded into dispatch_process_action from ha/worker; this matches smell 3 exactly.
- Next: remove that contaminated argument, update the single caller, validate, then delete the processed found_smell file.

- Edited ha/process_dispatch to remove the unused RuntimeConfig parameter and cleaned the only caller in ha/worker.
- Deleted the processed found_smell file as required by the skill.
- Next: run make lint and make test, fix anything they surface, then commit/push and switch tasks.

- make lint passed after the boundary cleanup.
- Next step is the full make test run via cargo nextest.
- If tests pass, I will commit the code change together with the required .ralph files, push, and run task_switch.

- make test failed during linker output assembly for test "ha" with missing .rcgu.o objects under target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/debug/deps.
- This failure looks unrelated to the RuntimeConfig boundary cleanup itself, so I am checking whether it is transient/environmental before deciding on the next recovery step.
- Next: inspect disk/build artifact state, then retry the mandated test if that looks safe.

- make test passed on rerun: 232 passed, 16 skipped, 5 leaky reported by nextest.
- The first make test failure appears transient/environmental because the identical tree passed immediately on rerun.
- Next: review git status, commit only the boundary cleanup plus required .ralph files, push, and run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- Removed the stray untracked smell note for the processed process-dispatch boundary.
- Preparing a selective commit: only src/ha/process_dispatch.rs, src/ha/worker.rs, and the required .ralph files will be staged.
- Unrelated dirty edits in .agents, src/pginfo/startup.rs, and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs remain intentionally unstaged.
